mandate: C306 — pre-registered costed OOS sweep of the COIN-M inverse quarterly futures term-structure / calendar-basis carry strategy over the real common term-structure grid (COIN-M perp 1h klines + dated quarterly 1h klines, data.binance.vision/data/futures/cm); per-asset annualized perp-vs-quarterly basis signal; long cheap / short rich basis trades, dollar-neutral within asset (long quarterly / short perp for cheap basis, short quarterly / long perp for rich basis), shift(1); inverse settlement PnL pnl_coin = notional_usd*(1/entry-1/exit)*signed_weight; cost grid [[0,0],[5,5],[10,10],[20,20],[40,40]] bps on ALL legs; benchmarks flat and equal-weight B&H-with-costs on same WF windows; train=720/test=168/step=168; 840 runs; edge rule identical to C285-C304.

config.position_rule: per-asset causal basis signal; long cheap/short rich basis trade within asset; +0.25 quarterly / -0.25 perp or reverse; gross 0.5 per active asset; shift(1); hold H
config.pnl_rule: inverse: pnl_coin = notional_usd * (1/entry_price - 1/exit_price) * signed_weight; ret_per_bar = (entry - exit) / exit * weight
config.cost_rule: cost charged on ALL legs (quarterly + perp) at (fee+slip) bps
config.benchmark: equal-weight buy-and-hold of the same legs with the same costs on the same WF windows
config.staleness_diagnostic: COIN-M quarterly archives have gaps between cycles; positions flat when basis non-finite

requirements: selected feature score finite (gap/warmup bars -> flat)
no NaN/non-finite perp or quarterly price in the selected leg
cross-section has >= 2K finite assets to rebalance
per-asset fallback trades by signal sign when only 1 asset active
no missing/None/false gate value treated as permissive
block and record reason if diagnostics fail
